scientific_integrity.claim_scope: All increasing partial injections on every finite labeled chain, each prescribed partial-identity target, and uniform-target asymptotics.
scientific_integrity.numeric_checks: Direct exhaustive checks at n=0..9 and analytic-cumulant recurrence checks at n=30,60,100.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Gap-bijection and simple-pole analytic cumulant method; computational enumeration is supporting only.

scientific_limitations: Uniform-target logarithmic limit, not uniform-root or fixed-point count limit.
OEIS A111960 already records the aggregated rank triangle; A111961 records the scalar totals and their asymptotic.
The corresponding full paper of Laradji and Umar (2015) was unavailable for whole-document priority comparison.
Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
title: Prescribed idempotent square roots and a logarithmic Gaussian law in increasing partial injections
